set -e; GH_PAT=$(grep ^GH_PAT= ~/bot/.env | cut -d= -f2-); if [ -z "$GH_PAT" ]; then echo NO-GH-PAT; exit 1; fi; RESP=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.github.com/gists -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_PAT" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" -d '{"public":false,"description":"oracle-vm-ops-channel","files":{"vm-ops.json":{"content":"{\"id\":\"init\",\"cmd\":\"\",\"result\":{}}"}}}' ); GIST_ID=$(echo "$RESP" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('id','FAILED'))"); echo "GIST_ID=$GIST_ID"; if [ "$GIST_ID" = "FAILED" ]; then echo "$RESP" | head -c 500; exit 1; fi; sudo mkdir -p /opt/vm-ops; sudo tee /opt/vm-ops/agent.py > /dev/null <<'AGENT_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Standalone VM ops agent - project-independent root command channel."""
import json, subprocess, time, urllib.request
BASE = "/opt/vm-ops"
GIST = open(f"{BASE}/gist_id").read().strip()
PAT = [l.split("=", 1)[1].strip() for l in open("/home/ubuntu/bot/.env") if l.startswith("GH_PAT=")][0]
URL = f"https://api.github.com/gists/{GIST}"
def api(method, data=None):
    req = urllib.request.Request(URL, method=method, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {PAT}", "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"})
    body = json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, data=body, timeout=30) as r:
        return json.load(r)
def get_doc():
    return json.loads(api("GET")["files"]["vm-ops.json"]["content"])
def main():
    try:
        last = get_doc().get("id")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"init failed: {e}", flush=True)
        last = None
    print(f"vm-ops-agent up, gist={GIST[:8]}..., last={last}", flush=True)
    while True:
        try:
            doc = get_doc()
            cid = doc.get("id")
            done = doc.get("result", {}).get("id")
            if cid and cid != last and done != cid and doc.get("cmd"):
                last = cid
                print(f"exec {cid}", flush=True)
                to = min(int(doc.get("timeout", 120)), 600)
                try:
                    p = subprocess.run(doc["cmd"], shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=to)
                    rc, out, err = p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    rc, out, err = 124, "", f"TIMEOUT after {to}s"
                doc["result"] = {"id": cid, "rc": rc, "out": out[-8000:], "err": (err or "")[-2000:], "at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())}
                api("PATCH", {"files": {"vm-ops.json": {"content": json.dumps(doc)}}})
                print(f"done {cid} rc={rc}", flush=True)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] error: {e}", flush=True)
        time.sleep(45)
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
AGENT_EOF
echo "$GIST_ID" | sudo tee /opt/vm-ops/gist_id > /dev/null; sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/vm-ops-agent.service > /dev/null <<'UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=VM ops agent (standalone root command channel)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/vm-ops/agent.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT_EOF
